spans.s: यशस् n. Glory, fame, reputation, यशस्तु रक्ष्यं परतो यशोधनैः R.iii.48.
यशस्कर a. conferring fame, glorious, M.viii.387.
यशस्काम a. eager for fame, ambitious.
यशस्-काय n. body in the form of fame, नास्ति येषां यशःकाये Bhartr.ii.24.
यशोद m. quick-silver.
यशोधन a. rich in fame, one whose wealth is fome, R.ii.1.
यशस्-पटह m. a double drum.
यशस्-विन् a. renowned, glorious.
यशस्-शेष (I) a. having left nothing but glory, i.e. dead.
यशस्-शेष (II) m. death.
यशस्य a. (f. स्या) 1. Famous, glorious; 2. bestowing, glory or distinction, M.i.106.
यशस्य a. (f. स्या) 1. Famous, glorious; 2. bestowing, glory or distinction, M.i.106.

यष्टि f. 1. A staff, a stick; 2. a column, a pillar; 3. a stem, a support; 4. a stalk; 5. a branch, चूतयष्टिरिवाभाशे मधौ परभृतोन्मुखी K.S.vi.2; 6. a string of pearls, a necklace, क्वचित्प्रभालेपिभिरिंद्रनीलैर्मुक्तामयी यष्टिरिवानुविद्धा R.xiii.54, K.S.v.8; 7. any creeping plant; (at the end of compounds the word is used to imply ‘thinness, slenderness,’ असंभृतं मंडनमंगयष्टेः K.S.i.31).
यष्टी f. The same as यष्टि q.v.
यष्टि-ग्रह m. a club-bearer, a staff-bearer.
यष्टि-निवास m. 1. a pole serving as a perch for birds; 2. a pigeon house standing on upright poles, वृक्षेशया यष्टिनिवासभङ्गात् R.xvi.14.
यष्टि-प्राण a. powerless, feeble, out of breath.
यष्टिक m. A lapwing.
यष्टिका f. 1. A staff, a stick; 2. a pearl necklace of one string.
याष्टीक m. A warrior armed with a club.
यष्टृ m. A worshiper, a sacrificer.

यस् vi. 1P, 4P (pp. यस्त; pres. यसाति, यस्यति) To strive, to endeavur, to labour.With आ-, 1. to endeavour; 2. to be afflicted, e.g. नायस्यसि तपस्यंती गुरून् सम्यगतूतुषः.With प्र-, 1. to strive, to endeavour.
यस् Caus. (यासयति-ते) With आ-, to torment, to trouble.
यास्क m. Name of the author of the Nirukta.
